## Checklist

- [ ] Build and tests pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, docs/, comments) where needed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data committed
- [ ] i18n: en-US and pt-BR parity considered (both editions updated, or a follow-up issue opened)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed
